stories.title: Fantasy football managers, beware: The full 'Do Not Draft' list for 2026
stories.summary: The annual hit is back, with players Eric Karabell predicts are going earlier than they should in drafts this summer.

stories.title: Nelson, second-winningest NBA coach, dies at 86
stories.summary: Don Nelson, the second-winningest coach in NBA history and a five-time champion as a player, died at the age of 86 on Sunday.

stories.title: Lynx's McBride drops 43, sets WNBA 3-point mark
stories.summary: Minnesota Lynx guard Kayla McBride set the WNBA single-game record by making 10 3-pointers Sunday in a 103-90 victory over the Dallas Wings.

stories.title: Bridgewater retires again; Lions pivot to Dobbs
stories.summary: Quarterback Teddy Bridgewater is stepping away from the Detroit Lions and is retiring from the NFL, coach Dan Campbell said Sunday.

stories.title: A's Wilson sets record with 111th errorless game
stories.summary: Athletics shortstop Jacob Wilson, 24, set an MLB record for his position Sunday at Fenway Park, playing his 111th consecutive errorless game, passing former Baltimore Orioles infielder Mike Bordick, who had a 110-game stretch in 2002.
